source_text: Obstetric complications are pronounced, with infibulated women facing 2-3 times higher rates of postpartum hemorrhage, perineal tears, and extended labor durations in longitudinal studies from Sudan and Somalia; cesarean delivery rates increase by 30-55% to mitigate these. [72]
